title: The borrowed session
disclaimer: Fictional training scenario. These events, people, systems, and accounts do not describe ENSA Fes or any real campus incident.

runtime_rules.execution: Display authored fixtures only. Never execute commands, processes, network requests, or hostname resolution.
runtime_rules.dependency_rule: Every boolean flag named in a step's requires array must be true.
runtime_rules.completion_rule: Apply effects and points only after a successful interaction; completed steps are idempotent.
runtime_rules.locked_action_rule: Show blocked_feedback. Do not mutate state or deduct points.
runtime_rules.replay_rule: Reset to initial_state; clear local points, journal, and report answers.
runtime_rules.storage: Local game state only. Do not send the learner's report to any service.

briefing.objective: Investigate the demo workstation, preserve evidence, contain the host and reused session, verify a clean recovery, and submit a factual report.
briefing.starting_condition: A paused evidence snapshot is available. No active spread is occurring in this scenario. The training console remains available when the workstation is isolated.
briefing.priority_note: This exercise allows a short evidence capture before isolation. In a spreading incident, immediate containment may take priority.
briefing.first_objective: Reach the marked training console and inspect case IR-2026-001.

entities.address_note: All IPs use documentation-only TEST-NET ranges. All hostnames use the reserved .example namespace.

locations.label: Training response console
locations.placement_hint: Place in an accessible lab near the player spawn, with a visible objective marker.

evidence.title: Authentication timeline
lines: 2026-10-31T09:12:00Z AUTH session_refresh account=student.demo session=sess-demo-482 client=198.51.100.17 result=accepted
evidence.interpretation: The same session remained usable from a second source after the student's local sign-out request. The source address alone does not identify a person.

evidence.title: Endpoint observation
lines: 2026-10-31T09:09:00Z ENDPOINT app_started host=lab-ws-07.campus.example app=campus_update.exe signature=unrecognized account=student.demo
evidence.interpretation: An unrecognized app preceded the suspicious session use. This supports investigation, but does not establish the mechanism of session theft.

evidence.title: Demo resource audit
lines: 2026-10-31T09:13:00Z AUDIT read account=student.demo session=sess-demo-482 client=198.51.100.17 resource=/training/meeting-notes.txt result=allowed
evidence.interpretation: The reused session accessed one fictional training file. The available evidence cannot establish access beyond this recorded event.

evidence.title: Preserved evidence bundle
lines: Contents: EV-01 authentication log; EV-02 endpoint snapshot; EV-03 resource audit; session metadata; UTC timeline
Integrity fingerprint: SIM-IR001-EVIDENCE-V1-7C42 (simulation token; not a cryptographic digest)
Store status: read-only; available after isolation and restore
evidence.interpretation: The case journal preserves these fixtures separately from the workstation before recovery changes its state.

evidence.title: Recovery verification record
lines: Local health and unrecognized-app check, while isolated: PASS
Old session sess-demo-482, simulated identity test: REJECTED
Controlled reconnection: completed after all preflight checks passed
Demo portal access with a fresh training session: PASS
Post-reconnect observation window: no repeated alerts in the simulated sample
evidence.interpretation: These authored checks justify recovery within this exercise. A quiet sample is not a guarantee that every possible threat is absent.

steps.title: Inspect the case

output_lines: CASE IR-2026-001 | host lab-ws-07.campus.example | account student.demo
Evidence opened: EV-01 authentication; EV-02 endpoint; EV-03 resource audit.
Unrecognized app at 09:09Z; session accepted from a second source at 09:12Z.
Observed access: one fictional training file. Mechanism and wider scope remain unconfirmed.
Snapshot paused. No active spread observed. Next: preserve the snapshot.

steps.journal_entry: Inspected EV-01, EV-02, and EV-03. Suspected session reuse affects lab-ws-07 and student.demo; the theft mechanism is unknown.
steps.feedback: Start with observations. The app alert and session timeline guide the response; they do not prove every part of the incident.
steps.blocked_feedback: Open the training console to inspect the case.

steps.title: Preserve the evidence

output_lines: Saved IR-2026-001-evidence-v1 to the simulated read-only evidence store.
Included: authentication log, endpoint snapshot, resource audit, session metadata, UTC timeline.
Collector: trainee.demo | captured 2026-10-31T09:16:00Z
Fingerprint: SIM-IR001-EVIDENCE-V1-7C42 — simulation token only.
EV-ARCHIVE added to journal. Next: isolate the workstation.

steps.journal_entry: Preserved the paused snapshot as EV-ARCHIVE, with source labels, UTC timestamps, collector, and a simulated integrity fingerprint.
steps.feedback: Restore operations can replace local evidence. This paused snapshot can be collected safely before isolation; a spreading incident may require containment first.
steps.blocked_feedback: Inspect the case first so you know which host, session, and records to preserve.

steps.title: Isolate the workstation

output_lines: lab-ws-07: simulated network access blocked.
Training console and preserved evidence remain available.
Identity status: sess-demo-482 is still valid on the simulated identity service.
Next: revoke that session.

steps.journal_entry: Isolated the affected workstation. Evidence remains available in the separate case journal.
steps.feedback: Isolation limits this machine's activity. A session already copied elsewhere can remain usable until it is explicitly revoked.
steps.blocked_feedback: Preserve this scenario's paused evidence snapshot before isolating the workstation.

steps.title: Revoke the reused session

output_lines: Identity service: id.campus.example (simulated).
Session sess-demo-482 invalidated for student.demo across the demo service.
Further use of that session will be rejected, including from 198.51.100.17.
Workstation remains isolated. Next: restore the approved lab image.

steps.journal_entry: Revoked sess-demo-482 across the simulated identity service after isolating the workstation.
steps.feedback: Endpoint containment and identity containment solve different parts of this case. Revocation removes the copied session's access.
steps.blocked_feedback: Isolate the workstation first to contain its activity while you revoke the reused session.

steps.title: Restore the approved baseline

output_lines: Approved training image selected: CLEAN-LAB-2026.10.
Simulated image restore complete. Workstation remains isolated.
Evidence bundle IR-2026-001-evidence-v1 remains preserved.
Recovery status: NOT YET VERIFIED. Next: run recovery checks.

steps.journal_entry: Restored the approved lab baseline while isolated. Preserved evidence and session revocation remain in effect.
steps.feedback: A known baseline supports recovery. A successful restore message alone does not show that the host and account are ready for normal use.
steps.blocked_feedback: Preserve evidence, isolate the workstation, and revoke the reused session before restoring the baseline.

steps.title: Verify recovery and reconnect

output_lines: PRECHECK, while isolated: approved-image comparison PASS.
PRECHECK, while isolated: local health and unrecognized-app check PASS.
PRECHECK, simulated identity test: sess-demo-482 REJECTED.
All preflight checks passed. Controlled simulated reconnection completed.
POSTCHECK: fresh training session and demo portal access PASS.
POSTCHECK: no repeated alerts in the simulated observation window.
EV-VERIFY saved. Recovery verified for this exercise. Next: write the report.

steps.journal_entry: Verified the baseline and local health while isolated, confirmed rejection of the old session, then reconnected under observation and confirmed demo service. Saved EV-VERIFY.
steps.feedback: Check the baseline and old session before reconnecting. Then verify expected service under observation. A quiet sample supports this recovery decision without proving every possible threat is absent.
steps.blocked_feedback: Finish the approved-image restore while the workstation is isolated and the reused session is revoked.

steps.title: Write the incident report

output_lines: Report saved to the local training journal.
Included: learner summary, evidence references, actions, verification, limits, and follow-up.
Case IR-2026-001 complete. Review the debrief or replay the mission.

steps.journal_entry: Submitted the learner's factual incident report with evidence references and recovery verification.
steps.feedback: A clear handover records what happened, what you preserved, what you changed, how you checked recovery, and what still needs review.
steps.blocked_feedback: Complete recovery verification and controlled reconnection before submitting the final report.

report_form.title: Incident handover

prefill.integrity_note: SIM-IR001-EVIDENCE-V1-7C42 is a simulated fingerprint, not a cryptographic digest.
prefill.actions: Preserved the snapshot; isolated lab-ws-07; revoked sess-demo-482; restored CLEAN-LAB-2026.10; passed preflight checks; reconnected under observation.
prefill.verification: EV-VERIFY: approved baseline and local health passed; old session rejected; fresh demo service passed; no repeated alerts in the sample.
prefill.limits: The mechanism of session theft and any access beyond the recorded training-file event remain unconfirmed.

fields.label: Write a short factual summary
fields.placeholder: Describe the affected host, suspicious session use, and response in your own words.
fields.invalid_feedback: Add a short summary of what you observed and how you responded (20–400 characters).
fields.hint: The demo workstation ran an unrecognized app, then its session appeared from a second source. I preserved evidence, contained the host and session, and verified the approved restore.

fields.label: What does the evidence support?

options.label: Suspicious reuse of the demo session; theft mechanism unconfirmed
The source address proves who took the session
The logs prove every campus system was compromised

fields.invalid_feedback: The logs show suspicious session reuse. They do not identify a person or establish campus-wide impact.

fields.label: Attach the preservation and recovery records

options.label: An unsupported guess about the person responsible

fields.invalid_feedback: Attach the preserved source bundle and the verification record; exclude unsupported attribution.

fields.label: Choose a useful follow-up

options.label: Monitor for recurrence and review how the demo session was exposed
Guarantee that no future incident is possible

fields.invalid_feedback: Preserve the handover evidence and plan a review of the exposure and any recurring signals.

report_form.submission_rule: All field validations must pass before the report step can apply its success effects. Evaluate exact_set without regard to ordering. Whitespace-only summaries are invalid.

debrief.title: Recovery is complete; explain your decisions
takeaways: Preserve evidence that recovery may replace, when the incident's urgency allows it.
Isolating a device and revoking a session address different sources of continued access.
Restore from an approved baseline and verify before normal service resumes.
Record facts, evidence, actions, verification, uncertainty, and follow-up in the handover.
This scenario's paused snapshot allows capture first. A spreading incident can require immediate containment.

reflection_questions.question: Why was isolating lab-ws-07 insufficient on its own?
options: A copied session could still be used elsewhere.
Isolation automatically deletes all service sessions.
reflection_questions.explanation: Device isolation limits that endpoint. The separate identity service needed an explicit session revocation.

reflection_questions.question: Would collecting evidence always come before isolation?
options: Yes; evidence collection always takes priority.
No; active spread can require immediate containment.
reflection_questions.explanation: The order here relies on a paused snapshot and no active spread. Response priorities depend on the observed urgency and available collection methods.

debrief.score_note: 100 points for completing the response and report. Reflection and retries are unscored.
